name: academic-research-skills
description: Suite of Claude Code skills for rigorous academic research, experimentation, paper writing, peer review, and pipeline orchestration. 8 skills covering the full research lifecycle from literature review to publication. v3.20 merges upstream Imbad0202 v3.13.0 → v3.17.0 (Stage 5/6 boundary semantics, canonical cross-model handoff envelope, opt-in model tiering, risk-stratified citation verification, sprint-contract panel checker, vendored release-discipline toolkit) on top of v3.19's provider-agnostic cross-model verification and v3.17's auto-by-default pipeline (unattended runs; set ARS_INTERACTIVE=1 to restore prompts). English-only output. Builds on v3.16's upstream Imbad0202 v3.4.0–v3.7.3 merge (PRISMA-trAIce + RAISE compliance agent, sprint contract gates, generator-evaluator contract, passport reset boundary, literature corpus adapters, trust-provenance hardening, claim faithfulness locator, contaminated-source advisory) and the fork's v3.15 experiment pipeline (PaperOrchestra + Lu 2026 + experiment-designer / data-analyst / simulation-runner / lab-notebook). Optional integrations: Semantic Scholar + OpenAlex (citation graph APIs), PaperBanana MCP (methodology diagrams), Google Colab MCP (GPU compute).
